sources.entry: zensical - A modern static site generator for technical documentation.

summary.one_liner: Zensical is a modern static site generator for building searchable, customizable technical documentation sites from Markdown, made by the creators of Material for MkDocs.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Zensical as a static site generator where you write documentation in Markdown and it produces a documentation site for open source or commercial projects. The site is described as searchable, customizable, supporting more than 60 languages, and suitable for all devices. The README points to external documentation at zensical.org/docs/ for setup and details. It also mentions optional paid-or-free add-ons: Zensical Studio, a tool for authoring docs in Zensical and MkDocs projects with project-aware editing and refactoring, and Zensical Spark, which offers early access, support, and collaboration options for organizations. The README states Zensical itself remains MIT-licensed and free.
use_cases: build a project documentation website from Markdown
publish technical docs for an open source project
migrate or author docs in MkDocs-style projects
notable: Built by the creators of Material for MkDocs
Optional Zensical Studio editor with project-aware refactoring for Zensical and MkDocs projects
caveats: README gives no install or run commands; setup details are on the external docs site
Zensical Spark Community opens to individuals only on November 5 (year not stated)
Studio and Spark are optional add-ons and their pricing or tiers are not detailed in the README
